evidence: Matches 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet import logic and descriptor handling in `src/wallet/imports.cpp` and `src/wallet/wallet.cpp`.
rationale: Resolves a long-standing user request (#27336) by allowing wallets to import public descriptors without re-supplying private keys when the wallet already owns them. As the author notes, forcing users to explicitly pass private keys 'is not ideal as it means exposing private key material' over RPC.
